createcityexpansioncore.ponder.shared.fg: Production feeds the warehouse. Use belts, funnels or other Create machinery instead of filling every order by hand.
The warehouse is BEHIND the Packager. The arrow points from the inventory towards the packaging face.
Build a physical package connection from the Packager to the Postbox. Nearby blocks are not automatically connected.
Link the Postbox to a real train station using Create. The train needs attached cargo inventory and must stop here for mail transfer.
At the destination, CCEC validates sealed packages and moves goods into a chest, barrel, Create Item Vault or Contract Intake.
First deliver a small real order. Setup checks blocks and addresses; only real cargo proves the conveyor and train handoff work. No test goods or CR are created.
For a distributed warehouse, connect stock-side Packagers through Stock Links to the same Create network.
The Stock Ticker requests goods from that network. Network signals carry requests, not items: packages still need a physical path.
Collect and unpack warehouse requests into a local dispatch buffer behind the CCEC Packager. Use a separate local collection address.
Current CCEC dispatch draws from its local Packager. Create handles warehouse replenishment; CCEC does not yet generate Stock Ticker network orders or automatic return trips.

createcityexpansioncore.ponder.shared.fl: Production continuously fills storage. CCEC automatically requests goods from its Packager for an active delivery.
Storage is BEHIND the Packager. The guide’s gold arrow points outwards from storage.
Packages travel on a real belt. Connect it through funnels to the Postbox: nearby blocks do not connect automatically.
Link the Postbox to a station using Create. A stopped train needs attached cargo inventory.
Pylon → Logistics → Terminals → New terminal. Select Packager and Postbox in the world; save after the checks pass.
Stock Links and a Stock Ticker can collect resources from a large Create network.
The receiving Packager replenishes the shared buffer. A separate CCEC Packager sends goods only to the active delivery address.
CCEC draws from the Packager’s local storage. Replenish that buffer using normal Create machinery; CCEC does not issue Stock Ticker requests.
The buyer chooses their free train or a published seller train, compares routes and sets the overall road CR allowance.
Empty pickup runs automatically. After a batch loads, the train departs for the receiver; the whole order need not fit in one trip.
The receiver is a DIFFERENT warehouse. Here CCEC checks the seal and address, accepts goods and updates the delivered quantity.
Goods and roads are separate. Road escrow settles for actual travel and refunds the remainder. Another batch may follow.
At a centre, parcels remain SEALED in warehouse storage. This neither accepts the goods nor pays the seller.
The centre preserves the parcel seal and changes only its next-stop address. Multiple orders can share one train.
Configure a real train on each leg with a cyclic Create schedule: adjacent stations, stops and time for parcel exchange.
Only the final terminal counts goods. Shared trip road costs split by cargo quantity within each order’s allowance.

For automatic replenishment, attach a Factory Gauge to a SEPARATE receiving Packager and set the item, stock level and address. It requests shortages from the Stock Link network; incoming parcels unpack into the dispatch buffer.

ccec.center.hint.LINE_CREATE: Stops define A → B → C service. The fee applies to every adjacent shipment leg. Reverse service needs a separate line. Availability requires a running cyclic train schedule through these stations. The operator dispatches charters; purchasing does not start a train.
ccec.center.hint.LINE_EDIT: The fee applies to every shipment leg. Changing mode neither starts trains nor replaces schedules. A return timetable does not create reverse cargo service.

ccec.center.delivery_error.quote_expired: The quote expired. Calculate again, review the new price and confirm.
ccec.center.delivery_error.quote_changed: Delivery terms changed. Calculate again and review the price, route and carrier before confirming.
ccec.center.hint.LINE_CHARTER: Delegates these trains to funded orders. Requires management of the line and every train. Manual schedules are never replaced. Trains wait for physical loading/unloading receipts. Returning requires a reverse path. Disable after active orders finish.

ccec.center.error.charter_busy: Train assigned to another order. Choose another service or wait for completion.
ccec.center.error.charter_not_ready: Train not ready. Check conductor, stationary position at a station and absence of a manual timetable. Exit manual control using Create.
ccec.center.error.charter_dispatch_block: Dispatch stopped. Check train, conductor, permissions and stations. Do not pay again. If no boxes were issued, cancel the order and calculate again.
